note: City of Atlantic campground in a reclaimed quarry with three fishing lakes, on the northwest edge of town: rows of back-in sites in open grass east of the south lake, a trail around the lakes, a fishing dock, playground and dog park. --Claude
summary: Campspot read: $25 + $2 booking fee confirmed; 38 back-in full-hookup sites (30/50 amp, 55 ft) -> count 35 -> 38, electric 50 and max rig 55 added; bathhouse; reservable with walk-in registration at the host. City page blocked. Lakes are 7+ ha (not ponds) but the nearest pads are ~60 m back behind a trail and shore shrubs: lakefront looks like lakeview (lead).
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview): the three quarry lakes are well over 5 acres (the south lake ~450 x 200 m on imagery), so they are lakes, not ponds. The campground's rows sit in open grass east of the south lake; on 0.37 m/px imagery (41.4146,-95.0148) the westmost pads are ~55-65 m from the water, with the lake trail (a gravel path) and a continuous shrub/tree fringe along the shore between them, and the fishing dock and playground (day use) to the north. Beyond the ~50 m bound and screened at the edge: open view across the grass, so lakeview at best. The stored value had no per-entry evidence (commit-level only).
